# gymtracker

> A calorie and macro tracker that runs entirely in the visitor's browser. Food
> entries, body weight readings and daily targets are stored in the browser's
> own IndexedDB database. There is no account, no server-side storage and no
> analytics. The only request the application ever makes to a third party is a
> barcode lookup against Open Food Facts, and only when someone scans or types
> a barcode.

## Pages

- [gymtracker](https://gymtracker.kucera.uk/): what the application is and how it works.
- [Privacy](https://gymtracker.kucera.uk/privacy): what is stored, where it is stored, and the single thing that leaves the device.

## Notes

- The application screens at /log, /history and /settings render no meaningful
  content without the visitor's own local database, so they are marked noindex
  and are not listed here.
- Source code: https://github.com/duvvy8/gymtracker
